# 核心依赖库（C库，C++直接调用）
libffi        -> ctypes完整实现
zlib          -> zlib zipfile gzip
sqlite3       -> sqlite3
openssl       -> ssl hashlib
libmpdec      -> decimal
libbz2        -> bz2
liblzma(xz)   -> lzma
libuuid       -> uuid
expat         -> xml.expat
readline      -> readline
ncurses       -> curses
gdbm          -> dbm

# 系统自带API（Windows，无需额外库）
winsock2      -> socket
win32 api     -> os shutil subprocess threading signal winreg mmap
c++17 std::filesystem -> pathlib
c++ std::chrono -> time calendar

# 纯手写、仅依赖C++标准库
bisect heapq itertools statistics enum weakref collections argparse logging inspect traceback pdb csv configparser
